uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When the user receives damage from nearby Pokémon from the opposing team, the damaging Pokémon becomes paralyzed. This Ability goes on a 15s cooldown when triggered. When the user hits with a boosted attack, Thunder Shock, or Thunderbolt, they create an electric field. This field will remain for 3s, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon in it by 30%. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2.5s.

Gains a Boosted Attack every 8s, launching a powerful electric orb and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. If any move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the user's boosted attack cooldown is reduced by 1s.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Attack with a jolt of electricity. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon, it also zaps a nearby opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to them.

Unleash a strong electric blast to the designated area, dealing damage and paralyzing opposing Pokémon. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2.5s.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 6% of the current cooldown for each Pokémon hit.

Has the user let loose 2 waves of electricity from their feathers, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and leaving them paralyzed. If there is an electric field within this move's area of effect, the electric field is absorbed, increasing this move's area of effect and releasing a third wave of electricity. The second and third waves deal a stacking 15% increased damage to Pokémon hit by the preceeding waves. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2.5s.

Fire an electric cannon-like blast that explodes on contact, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon caught in the explosion's area of effect. When the electric orb passes through an electric field, it absorbs the field, increasing its size, travel distance, and damage dealt. Opposing Pokémon caught in the explosion are also left unable to act for 0.3s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 1s cooldown between uses.
When the electric orb passes through an electric field, the orb's size increases, along with the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act.

Has the user continuously drop lightning bolts in the designated area every 1s. If the user moves a certain distance from the area, it will be dragged towards the user's position. Electric fields are created where the lightning strikes. The lightning bolts paralyze and deal damage to opposing Pokémon they hit. If lightning bolts hit the same Pokémon 3 consecutive times, that Pokémon will be left unable to act. If lightning bolts hit one of the opposing team's goal zones 5 times, that goal zone will become defenseless (scoring is instant) for 5s or until a goal is scored. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2.5s.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
